column1: food|/fuːd/|n.|食物；食品|基础|food-drinks|fresh food::新鲜食物;food waste::食物浪费|We bought fresh food at the morning market.::我们在早市买了新鲜食物。|The school is trying to reduce food waste.::学校正努力减少食物浪费。

water|/ˈwɔːtər/|n.; v.|水；给……浇水|基础|food-drinks|drinking water::饮用水;water the plants::给植物浇水|There is clean drinking water near the entrance.::入口附近有干净的饮用水。|Could you water the plants while I am away?::我外出期间，你能给植物浇水吗？
milk|/mɪlk/|n.|奶；牛奶|基础|food-drinks|a glass of milk::一杯牛奶;fresh milk::鲜奶|She poured a little milk into her tea.::她往茶里倒了少许牛奶。|We need to buy fresh milk for breakfast.::我们需要买鲜奶当早餐饮品。
bread|/bred/|n.|面包|基础|food-drinks|a loaf of bread::一条面包;a slice of bread::一片面包|He bought a loaf of bread on his way home.::他回家途中买了一条面包。|The bread was still warm from the oven.::面包刚出炉，还热着。
rice|/raɪs/|n.|大米；米饭|基础|food-drinks|a bowl of rice::一碗米饭;grow rice::种水稻|We shared a bowl of rice and some vegetables.::我们分着吃了一碗米饭和一些蔬菜。|Farmers grow rice in the fields near the river.::农民在河边的田地里种水稻。

fruit|/fruːt/|n.|水果；果实；成果|基础|food-drinks|fresh fruit::新鲜水果;bear fruit::取得成果|There is fresh fruit on the kitchen table.::厨房桌子上有新鲜水果。|Their careful planning is finally beginning to bear fruit.::他们周密的规划终于开始取得成果。
vegetable|/ˈvedʒtəbəl/|n.|蔬菜|基础|food-drinks|fresh vegetables::新鲜蔬菜;vegetable soup::蔬菜汤|They grow vegetables in a small garden.::他们在一个小花园里种蔬菜。|I made vegetable soup for the family.::我给家人做了蔬菜汤。
meat|/miːt/|n.|肉；食用肉|基础|food-drinks|fresh meat::鲜肉;eat meat::吃肉|The shop sells fresh meat and fish.::这家商店出售鲜肉和鱼。|Some guests do not eat meat.::有些客人不吃肉。
fish|/fɪʃ/|n.; v.|鱼；鱼肉；钓鱼|基础|food-drinks|fresh fish::鲜鱼;go fishing::去钓鱼|We watched small fish moving through the clear water.::我们看着小鱼游过清澈的水。|They like to fish by the lake on weekends.::他们喜欢周末在湖边钓鱼。
egg|/eɡ/|n.|蛋；卵|基础|food-drinks|a boiled egg::煮蛋;lay eggs::产卵|She had a boiled egg for breakfast.::她早餐吃了一个煮蛋。|The birds lay their eggs in spring.::这些鸟在春天产卵。
sugar|/ˈʃʊɡər/|n.|糖；食糖|基础|food-drinks|a spoonful of sugar::一勺糖;add sugar::加糖|Do you take sugar in your coffee?::你喝咖啡时加糖吗？|The recipe calls for a spoonful of sugar.::这个食谱需要一勺糖。
salt|/sɔːlt/|n.|盐；食盐|基础|food-drinks|a little salt::少许盐;add salt::加盐|Add a little salt to the warm water.::往温水里加少许盐。|The soup needs more salt before serving.::这道汤上桌前还需要再加一点盐。
oil|/ɔɪl/|n.|油；石油|基础|food-drinks|cooking oil::食用油;oil prices::石油价格|Heat a little cooking oil in the pan.::在锅里加热少许食用油。|Oil prices rose during the winter.::石油价格在冬季上涨了。
meal|/miːl/|n.|一餐；饭食|基础|food-meals|a hot meal::一顿热饭;an evening meal::晚餐|We enjoyed a hot meal after the long walk.::长途步行后，我们吃了一顿热饭。|The evening meal brought everyone together.::晚餐把大家聚到了一起。
breakfast|/ˈbrekfəst/|n.|早餐|基础|food-meals|have breakfast::吃早餐;before breakfast::早餐前|We had breakfast beside the open window.::我们坐在打开的窗边吃早餐。|She takes a short walk before breakfast.::她在早餐前散一小会儿步。
lunch|/lʌntʃ/|n.|午餐|基础|food-meals|have lunch::吃午餐;a lunch break::午休时间|Would you like to have lunch with us?::你愿意和我们一起吃午餐吗？|I read a few pages during my lunch break.::我利用午休读了几页书。
dinner|/ˈdɪnər/|n.|晚餐；一天中的正餐|基础|food-meals|have dinner::吃晚餐;after dinner::晚餐后|We invited our neighbors to dinner.::我们邀请邻居来吃晚餐。|The family usually talks about the day after dinner.::这家人通常在晚餐后聊当天的事。
cook|/kʊk/|v.; n.|烹饪；厨师|基础|food-meals|cook a meal::做饭;a good cook::好厨师|I learned to cook a few simple meals.::我学会了做几道简单饭菜。|The cook prepared food for thirty guests.::厨师为三十位客人准备了食物。

kitchen|/ˈkɪtʃən/|n.|厨房|基础|home-objects|a small kitchen::小厨房;a kitchen table::厨房餐桌|The kitchen gets bright sunlight in the morning.::厨房在早晨能照到明亮的阳光。|Everyone helped clean the kitchen after the meal.::饭后大家一起帮忙打扫厨房。
table|/ˈteɪbəl/|n.|桌子；表格|基础|home-objects|a dining table::餐桌;a table of results::结果表|Please put the plates on the dining table.::请把盘子放到餐桌上。|The table shows the results of the experiment.::这张表展示了实验结果。

chair|/tʃer/|n.|椅子；主席职位|基础|home-objects|a comfortable chair::舒适的椅子;take the chair::主持会议|Pull up a chair and join our discussion.::搬把椅子过来，加入我们的讨论。|She agreed to take the chair at the meeting.::她同意主持这次会议。
bed|/bed/|n.|床；河床；花坛|基础|home-objects|go to bed::上床睡觉;a flower bed::花坛|I usually go to bed before eleven.::我通常在十一点前睡觉。|There is a flower bed beside the gate.::大门旁有一片花坛。
window|/ˈwɪndoʊ/|n.|窗；窗口|基础|home-objects|open a window::开窗;a window seat::靠窗的座位|Open the window to let in some fresh air.::打开窗户，让一些新鲜空气进来。|She chose a window seat on the train.::她在火车上选了一个靠窗的座位。
door|/dɔːr/|n.|门；入口|基础|home-objects|the front door::前门;next door::隔壁|Someone left a parcel by the front door.::有人把一个包裹放在了前门旁。|Our new neighbors live next door.::我们的新邻居就住在隔壁。
wall|/wɔːl/|n.|墙；墙壁；屏障|基础|home-objects|a stone wall::石墙;on the wall::在墙上|An old map hangs on the wall.::墙上挂着一张旧地图。|A low stone wall separates the two gardens.::一道矮石墙将两个花园隔开。
floor|/flɔːr/|n.|地板；楼层|基础|home-objects|the ground floor::底层;on the floor::在地板上|She spread the papers on the floor.::她把文件铺在了地板上。|The reading room is on the second floor.::阅览室在二楼。
roof|/ruːf/|n.|屋顶；顶部|基础|home-objects|a flat roof::平屋顶;under one roof::在同一屋檐下|Rain was falling through a hole in the roof.::雨从屋顶的一个洞里落下来。|Three generations live together under one roof.::三代人生活在同一屋檐下。
rent|/rent/|n.; v.|租金；租用；出租|基础|home-services|pay rent::付租金;rent a room::租房间|They rent a room near the university.::他们在大学附近租了一个房间。|The monthly rent includes water and heating.::月租金包含水费和供暖费。
repair|/rɪˈper/|v.; n.|修理；修补|基础|home-services|repair a bicycle::修自行车;in need of repair::需要修理|He learned to repair his own bicycle.::他学会了修理自己的自行车。|The wooden bridge is in need of repair.::这座木桥需要修缮。

furniture|/ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər/|n.|家具|基础|home-objects|a piece of furniture::一件家具;wooden furniture::木制家具|The room has very little furniture.::房间里的家具很少。|They make wooden furniture in a small workshop.::他们在一个小作坊里制作木制家具。
